A finite dominant map is surjective (closed image + density), so the fiber over the missing chart point exists and deg F ≥ 1 UNCONDITIONALLY; the Riemann inequality turns any class of degree ≥ 1 − χ into an effective witness; the dévissage peeling surjections descend H¹-vanishing along effective subtraction; and the assembled CLASS FORM — for any class l and any θ of positive degree, all divisor realizations of l·θⁿ have vanishing H¹ for n ≥ n₀ — with witness-independence by the per-degree class-invariance. The Θ-vs-Weil-divisor bridge deliberately sidestepped: the statement quantifies over an abstract positive-degree class, so the consumer supplies its own fiber class and no chart-convention identification is ever needed. Plus the rank anchor h⁰(𝒪(D)) = deg D + χ(𝒪) under vanishing H¹ — the locally-free-rank input for the base-change engine. Frontiered with a recorded recipe: the internal dominance discharge for the constructed map to ℙ¹ (true by its η ↦ η construction, unexported — a small stalk-integrality brick or an export from the landed curve layer). The finiteness is honest mathematics, not convenience: for quasi-finite non-finite covers the bare piece-triviality is FALSE (counterexample recorded — a product of two localizations of a two-dimensional normal local ring with nontrivial class group), and the general faithfully-flat form survives with piece-selection as hypothesis. The moving lemma, divisor-free (the curve over the cover is not integral — the meromorphic route was unusable and replaced): an invertible module over the piece ring trivializes away from one element avoiding the finite fiber-prime set (semilocal Pic-triviality + prime avoidance + denominator clearing, cyclic-invertible-is-free by the dual-pairing trick), pushed through the algebraic tube (going-up on principal ideals — no closed maps, no images); subscheme triviality becomes a trimmed trivializing cochain by unit-preimage transport and unit-sheaf reindex-gluing. The generic-point-to-generic-point fact was already proven inside the locally-quasi-finite construction (and is genuinely needed: a finite map to ℙ¹ can be constant, so no standalone derivation from finiteness alone exists); the construction's postcondition is strengthened in place with a two-line projection wrapper keeping the original name byte-compatible for its consumers, and the curve-level keystone lands: ∃ π finite AND dominant with π ≫ structureMap = C.hom. Smoke-checked: both FLV vanishing forms now apply to the constructed map with no manual dominance hypothesis — the FLV campaign's final frontier is discharged.
